regions.merged_text: God bless you Nrs. O'Donnell, away out there in the (once-upon-a- time) wooley West, in reality just across the Mississippi some 25 miles up from my birth - blace - 4 miles below Prescott. At that time in 1870 it was indeed a pioneer portion but a wonderfully picturesque section of the Country. Well I just had a talk with Joe and we are surely pleased that your trouble is so hopefully checked - and promising. I hope it may prove to have been the climax, left over from the old year, etc after all, however if, "Thoom the Lord loveth He chasteneth," we ought to thank God for the privileg of being mode to resemble His divine Najesty ... so now I'll say Good Night and again God bless you and yours - speedy recovery . . . Fr. Solanus, O.F.K.Cap.
